PLAY · FOLLOWING A COLOR KEY

Unicorn’s Rainbow Route

Follow the key: red, then blue, then yellow. Color the path colors in that order to reach the castle!

HOW TO DO IT

Read, then draw.

Follow the key: red, then blue, then yellow. Color the path colors in that order to reach the castle!

On the rainbow route!

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear appear right here and work straight on the picture. Save keeps your finished work as a picture.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This adventure is cleared for you the moment you save your finished picture. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! Castle reached! Your saved work is in your downloads, and the ribbon is on in the library.

      FOR GROWN-UPS

      Why this adventure helps.

      This activity trains following a color key right on the puzzle picture: one short written instruction, then real pencil work — circling, crossing, tracing and connecting on the illustration itself. Nothing is graded. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud while they draw — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

      Prefer paper? The Unicorn’s Rainbow Route worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
